scope: Standalone unchanged-surface context experiment, not actual AIO19 host or Skyrim acceptance
alpha: Probe checks every pixel in every source; RGB-only PPMs cannot independently verify alpha
retirement: Probe returned success after host.Retire(); not a complete lifecycle regression suite

definitions.linear: UNORM Gamma22 decode -> linear FP16 NR -> Gamma22 encode
definitions.srgb: UNORM sRGB decode -> linear FP16 NR -> sRGB encode
definitions.rawgamma: Encoded UNORM values intentionally labeled Linear; decode/encode bypass; research only
definitions.case2: 0x42, separately allocated retained pre-NR linear copy as Backbuffer
definitions.case3: 0x02, separately allocated retained pre-NR linear copy as Backbuffer
